evidence_review_policy.exactness: Existing message ID and nonblank exact source substring; no normalization.
evidence_review_policy.relevance: Quote must support the specific speaker, behavior and criterion, not merely match source.
evidence_review_policy.coverage: For multi-part or absence claims, record incomplete support separately from wrong labels. A no-flag finding should cover all operator turns.
evidence_review_policy.scale: Understandability is explicitly independent of politeness and external factual correctness.

limitations: Six short scenarios with four criteria each are not representative of the official eight-criterion rubric.
No successful verification before a protected action; no subtle violations or protected-action sequencing contrast.
All clarity labels are 10: levels 0/4 are untested.
The changed EN criterion and the old greeting criterion would both yield no; explanation review is essential and contrastive coverage is missing.
RU voice case is fictional text only, not audio evidence.
No external company knowledge is supplied; opening-hour truth is not assessed.
